scripts.postinstall: for d in backend frontend user-service classes-service registration-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm install 2>&1); done
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,user-svc,classes,registration,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green -c auto "cd backend && npm run start:dev" "cd user-service && npm run start:dev" "cd classes-service && npm run start:dev" "cd registration-service && npm run start:dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.lint: for d in backend frontend user-service classes-service registration-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm run lint 2>&1 || true); done
scripts.format: for d in backend frontend user-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm run format 2>&1 || true); done
scripts.typecheck: for d in backend frontend user-service classes-service registration-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm run typecheck 2>&1 || true); done
scripts.audit:fix: for d in backend frontend user-service classes-service registration-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm audit fix 2>&1 || true); done
